items.paraphrase: In dwellings above four storeys the run from any point inside a unit to its exit door is capped at 20 m, or 30 m if the unit is sprinklered.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; this is the leg inside the dwelling, the annex table has no apartment row

items.clause: Annex Ek-5/B, row for office buildings
items.paraphrase: Offices: 45 m to an exit with two escape directions and no sprinklers (75 m sprinklered); 15 m (30 m) when only one direction exists.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the raw table; columns are single-direction then two-direction, each unsprinklered then sprinklered

items.paraphrase: Entrance corridor up to the main stair or lift is at least 1.5 m wide in ordinary buildings and 2.2 m in public buildings.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; this is the entrance corridor, not a full accessible-route rule (that sits in TS 9111, not read)

items.paraphrase: Clear door width is at least 0.9 m for ordinary doors and 1.0 m for the entrance door of an independent unit.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; general minimum for all buildings in planned areas, not an accessibility-only clause

items.paraphrase: Turkish accessibility standard uses a 1.5 m turning space for wheelchairs.
items.note: unverifiable_free: searched 2026-11-14: web search (Turkish) for TS 9111 turning diameter; the standard is sold by TSE, only secondary guides and a tourism communique mirror repeat 150 cm; not read in the primary text

items.paraphrase: Ramp slope is 1:12 for a rise up to 15 cm, then flatter: 1:14 to 50 cm, 1:16 to 100 cm, 1:20 above.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; 1:12 is the steepest case (small rises)

items.paraphrase: Office buildings: 8000 m2 per compartment; residential buildings have no limit.
With suitable fire control systems (detection, sprinklers, smoke control) the office compartment limit may be doubled.
Riser may not exceed 16 cm in buildings without a lift and 18 cm in buildings with one.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; value is the no-lift case, 0.18 with lift; escape stairs in the fire regulation (Art. 41 para 7) allow 0.175

items.paraphrase: Tread is computed from twice the riser plus the tread being 60 to 64 cm, but never below 27 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; fire regulation escape stairs: 0.25 m minimum

items.paraphrase: Common stair flights and landings in housing are at least 1.2 m (1.5 m in other buildings), and not less than the escape width worked out under the fire regulation.
Stairs inside a single dwelling unit may be as narrow as 1.0 m.
Occupied storeys need 2.6 m clear height (2.4 m where an aviation limit fixes the storey count); bathrooms, store rooms and passages may drop to 2.2 m.
The same occupied-storey minimum of 2.6 m applies to offices.
